title: EV Specifications: comparison of 2020 SR+, 2021 SR+ and 2021 Long Range AWD
notes: North American entries: 2020 SR+ 52.4 kWh NCA 170 kW; 2021 SR+ 55.4 kWh NCA 170 kW; 2021 Long Range AWD 82.1 kWh NCA 250 kW. Single battery figure per car (gross/net not split); AC shown as 11.5 kW for all (conflicts with Tesla service manual for non-Long-Range packs).
